entities.summary: Nicholas Joseph LaLota is an American politician and veteran serving since 2023 as the U.S. representative for New York's 1st congressional district. He is a member of the Republican Party. Nick LaLota was a naval commanders from Bay Shore (b. 1978-06-23, Bay Shore). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
